signal.title: How to Evaluate General-Purpose Robot Policies for Real-World Deployment
signal.summary: 这项研究利用仿真或三维场景生成，为具身智能提供训练、测试和安全验证所需的可控环境。

editorial.intro: 这项研究利用仿真或三维场景生成，为具身智能提供训练、测试和安全验证所需的可控环境。
editorial.why_it_matters: 高质量仿真能够降低真实机器人试错成本，但关键在于生成环境是否保留了任务和物理约束。
editorial.watch_next: 继续核对仿真与真实环境之间的差距，以及是否能复现到真实机器人。

evidence.excerpt: How to Evaluate General-Purpose Robot Policies for Real-World Deployment | NVIDIA Technical Blog DEVELOPER Home Blog Forums Docs Downloads Training Join Technical Blog Subscribe Related Resources Robotics English 中文 How to Evaluate General-Purpose Robot Policies for Real-World Deployment Jul 11, 2026 By Jenai Xuning Yang Like Discuss (0) L T F R E AI-Generated Summary RoboLab is a simulation benchmarking platform built to evaluate general-purpose robot policies across diverse embodiments without visual domain overlap between training and evaluation. The platform introduces capability-specific tasks tagged by visual, procedural, and relational competencies to prevent benchmark saturation and enable targeted assessment of policy strengths. Evaluation goes beyond binary success rates with graded task scores, trajectory quality measured by SPARC spectral arc length, and execution speed metrics that capture motion efficiency and smoothness. Failure event logging and a built-in dashboard pinpoint exactly where policies fail, tracking wrong-object grasps, dropped objects, and gripper collisions during execution.
